beats.care: If you ride to pandals, slow down on painted stretches, especially when wet. Police may stop bikes there in rain.
beats.what: Bikes reportedly skidded on the newly painted Chingrighata flyover after rain. Viral videos raised road-safety worries.
beats.why: Officials added reflective studs and grip at Chingrighata, scraped paint at Gariahat, and removed it overnight in Asansol.

cards.body: Chingrighata got reflective studs and 'go slow' boards. Gariahat flyover's paint was scraped. Asansol's Bhagat Singh More lost its rainbow paint overnight.
cards.caption: painted spots fixed

opts: To reduce traffic jams near pandals
Wet painted surfaces can lose grip and make bikes skid
Because bikes damage the new paint
To make room for Puja buses
cards.q: Why would police restrict motorcycles on that flyover when it rains?
cards.why: The worry is grip: rain on a painted surface raised skid fears, so curbs are a safety step.

cards.body: Urban development minister Agnimitra Paul said anti-skid paint was used and the cause is being probed. CP Ajay Nand said engineers told him the paint has anti-skid properties.
cards.title: Officials vs the videos

cards.body: The minister said the paint job was paid for by a paint company's CSR funds, not government money.

cards.q: Painted, colourful roads in your city?

cover.label: Bikes slipped on a freshly painted flyover

hook: Why are bikers being told to avoid *painted flyovers* in the rain?

learn.t: Painted road markings can get slippery when wet, so engineers add grip using anti-skid paint or rougher surfaces.

sources.name: Millennium Post
sources.title: State takes corrective steps after bikes skid on painted roads

tldr: After bikes skidded on the freshly painted, rain-wet Chingrighata flyover, the state is adding studs and roughening painted roads, and police say they'll restrict motorcycles there when it rains.
